description: bar sends sigma -> sigma^{-1}, so bar is crossing reversal (mirror image). The bar-ODD part of the R-matrix is sigma - sigma^{-1} = a*1, which IS the Skein relation and is central; the bar-EVEN part is sigma + sigma^{-1} = [2]_q (P_+ - P_-). Hence the bar-odd channel is generated by a = q - q^{-1}. Falsifiable prediction checked: every S_odd from the qb8d pairing factors as a*(bar-EVEN).

assertions.name: r_matrix_bar_decomposition
assertions.detail: bar(sigma) = sigma^{-1} (crossing reversal); sigma - sigma^{-1} = a*1 is bar-ODD and CENTRAL -- it IS the Skein relation; sigma + sigma^{-1} = [2]_q (P_+ - P_-) is bar-EVEN, with P_+/P_- verified idempotent and summing to 1. Element-level, symbolic in q, both generators.

assertions.name: bar_odd_channel_is_a_generated[q = i        ([2]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: every nonzero S_odd factors as a * (bar-EVEN) with a = 2*I; 2 generators checked

assertions.name: bar_odd_channel_is_a_generated[q = zeta_6   ([3]_q = 0)]
assertions.detail: every nonzero S_odd factors as a * (bar-EVEN) with a = (sqrt(3) + 3*I)/(sqrt(3) - I); 1 generators checked

consequence: SHAPE constraint only: a bar-odd swing carried by this construction must have the form S = (q - q^{-1}) * (bar-even). This does NOT supply the magnitude and is NOT a derivation of c_3 -- the magnitude gate is bean qou-qb8e.
scope: scope-(a). n=3 mechanism check. The R-matrix decomposition itself is symbolic in q and n-independent (it is the Hecke quadratic relation), but the S_odd factorization is measured only at the two n=3 root-of-unity points.
